design.silhouette: recover into a guarded crouch, head lowered and weight returned forward
design.motion: secuencia de impacto: preparación, absorción, retroceso y recuperación; una pose distinta por fotograma
design.style: high-density HD pixel art, medieval fantasy RPG, warm outlines and textured materials

provenance.kind: original project art; pose isolated from a generated four-pose Hurt action reference
process: generate four poses for the same action in one batch
isolate the relevant pose and remove the presentation background
fit uniformly to a 128×256 cell without cropping the body
quantize visible artwork without dithering and reserve PNG palette index 0 for true transparency
provenance.note: Only the four individual PNG frames and their QA reports are stored for production; the reference board is not a runtime asset.

review.notes: Review four-frame Hurt cadence and silhouette consistency together before final 4×15 atlas assembly. Technical checks do not constitute artistic approval.
